description: JS answers a attachPaymentMethod request after an ephemeral-key init with an overriding adapter. Android decodes the payment method and returns it to the adapter; iOS only signals completion, because its CustomerAdapter attach call returns nothing.

parityGaps.result: G11: Android resolves an empty object; iOS resolves an empty array.
parityGaps.delivered: D7: iOS CustomerAdapter.attachPaymentMethod returns Void, so iOS ignores the payment method JS sends.
parityGaps.delivered.id: D7: Android CustomerAdapter.attachPaymentMethod returns the payment method, so Android decodes it.
